column1: # Injection source: ChEBI (Chemical Entities of Biological Interest), EBI public search API

# Mined: 2026-09-11. Entries are single-word compound names returned by ChEBI's search API for a fixed set of query terms (enzyme, protein, antibody, reagent, buffer, resin, chromatography), unfiltered beyond 'is one alphabetic word'. This source exists specifically to give the tier-assignment rule real Medium/HardReachable-tier coverage: coded identifier schemes (JIRA, CVE, PDB) are digit-bearing by construction and can never tier as anything but Easy.
# The harness (tests/injection_harness/tiers.rs) computes difficulty tier from the
# surface itself, at fixed wordlist depth — it is never read from this file.
